# Langdock
> Enterprise AI platform for company-wide AI adoption. Langdock provides model-agnostic AI chat, custom agents, workflow automation, and 60+ integrations — deployed securely on your own infrastructure with full GDPR compliance and EU data residency. ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type II certified. Used by 5,000+ companies.

Langdock bridges the gap between powerful AI models and productive, governed enterprise use. It enables organizations to roll out AI safely and flexibly across their entire organization — from individual contributors to company-wide deployments — without sacrificing security, compliance, or control.

## Products
- [Chat](https://langdock.com/products/chat): Model-agnostic AI chat for the whole organization. Access GPT-4, Claude, Gemini, and more in one interface with team collaboration, usage controls, and enterprise governance.
- [Agents](https://langdock.com/products/agents): Build custom AI agents with deep knowledge bases and tools to automate recurring tasks and support workflows.
- [Workflows](https://langdock.com/products/workflows): AI process automation with multi-step pipelines, AI actions, and human-in-the-loop checkpoints.
- [Integrations](https://langdock.com/products/integrations): 60+ native integrations including Confluence, SharePoint, Slack, Notion, Google Drive, Jira, and more. 750+ native actions.
- [API](https://langdock.com/products/api): Single enterprise-ready API for accessing leading AI models and Langdock agents directly from your own applications.
- [Mobile](https://langdock.com/mobile): iOS and Android apps for on-the-go AI access across the organization.

## Security & Compliance
- [Security Overview](https://langdock.com/security): ISO 27001, SOC 2 Type II, GDPR-compliant. EU data residency, on-premises and private cloud deployment, SSO, RBAC, audit logs, and data loss prevention.
- [Trust Center](https://trust.langdock.com): Certifications, compliance documents, penetration test reports, and security policies.
- [Privacy Policy](https://langdock.com/privacy-policy): How Langdock processes and protects personal data under GDPR.
- [Vulnerability Disclosure Policy](https://langdock.com/vulnerability-disclosure-policy): Responsible disclosure process for security researchers.

## Enterprise
- [Enterprise](https://langdock.com/enterprise): Dedicated infrastructure, custom SLAs, white-glove onboarding, and procurement-ready contracts. Deployed entirely on your own infrastructure if required.
- [Pricing](https://langdock.com/pricing): Plans starting with a 7-day free trial. Team and Enterprise tiers with custom deployment options.
- [Models](https://langdock.com/models): All AI models available in Langdock — GPT-4o, Claude, Gemini, Mistral, Llama, and more across all major providers.
